name: evidence-first-medical-writing
description: A bilingual, evidence-first workflow for planning, diagnosing, revising, and simulating independent peer review of medical research manuscripts.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-first workflow for medical research manuscripts
interface.longDescription: A bilingual, evidence-first workflow for planning, diagnosing, revising, and auditing medical research manuscripts. It connects research questions, study design, outcomes, integrity checks, evidence boundaries, manuscript structure, language, submission, reviewer responses, and independent multi-reviewer simulated peer review with editor adjudication and non-regression checks.
defaultPrompt: Audit this medical manuscript using an evidence-first workflow.
Build a title, abstract plan, and IMRaD outline for this study.
Rewrite these results without changing any facts or numbers.
Run two rounds of independent simulated peer review with a separate editor, citation audit, and non-regression check.
